scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.build:meta: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production --meta
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.update-utils: npm uninstall obsidian-dev-utils && npm install kalmanmoshe/obsidian-dev-utils#main
scripts.build:swiftlatex: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/build-swiftlatex.ps1 all && npm run generate:payloads
scripts.build:swiftlatex:pdftex: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/build-swiftlatex.ps1 pdftex && npm run generate:payloads
scripts.build:swiftlatex:xetex: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/build-swiftlatex.ps1 xetex && npm run generate:payloads
scripts.build:swiftlatex:dvi: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/build-swiftlatex.ps1 dvi && npm run generate:payloads
scripts.build:all: npm run build:swiftlatex && npm run build
